handbookNote: Mississippi Motorcycle Operator Manual, 17th Edition (Motorcycle Safety Foundation MOM, Feb. 2014 text), distributed unmodified by MS DPS -- official PDF at driverservicebureau.dps.ms.gov/sites/default/files/2023-07/S-Motorcycle%20%20Manual%2023.pdf, linked from the official Motorcycle License Requirements page driverservicebureau.dps.ms.gov/Drivers/Motorcycle_License_Reqs. Full text extracted via pdftotext and used as the sole grounding source. Unlike AL's 18th-edition manual, MS's copy has NO state-specific insert pages, statutory road-rule supplement, or DPS-added content of any kind -- it is the plain, unmodified national MSF booklet (same base text pattern as MS's separately-noted unmodified generic-AAMVA CDL manual), so no fabricated MS-specific traffic-law bucket was created; all content is grounded in the manual's own MSF chapters plus its full Three-Wheel Motorcycle/Sidecar Supplement -- price matches this project's established Motorcycle tier ($7.99), not a placeholder. EXAM MECHANICS: item count and passing score are HEDGED, not officially confirmed. Directly checked this session: the manual's own 'Earning Your License' section states only that a knowledge test and an on-cycle skill test are required, with no published item count or passing score anywhere in its text. Mississippi DPS Driver Service Bureau's official pages (driverservicebureau.dps.ms.gov/Drivers/Motorcycle_License_Reqs and /node/299 'Motorcycle Endorsement') were also checked directly and CONFIRM: (1) a motorcycle endorsement requires passing both a written (knowledge) test and a driving skills test, (2) completing an AAMVA-endorsed motorcycle safety course waives only the skills test -- the knowledge test is still required even with an approved course, and (3) an out-of-state license valid for motorcycle operation may waive both tests. However, NEITHER official DPS page states an exact question count or passing percentage. Third-party test-prep sites (driving-tests.org, zutobi.com, dmv-permit-test.com, epermittest.com) consistently report a 25-question test requiring 20 correct (80%) to pass, but this figure could NOT be verified on any official MS DPS page or in the manual itself during this session's direct checks, so it must be flagged as an unconfirmed, third-party-reported figure only in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time -- not government-confirmed verbatim, unlike the AAMVA-course skills-waiver fact above which IS officially confirmed. Content-depth rationale: this is the standard, fairly rich national MSF manual (full gear/vehicle-control/SEE-intersections/conspicuity/crash-avoidance/dangerous-surface/mechanical-problem/animal-and-flying-object/passenger-cargo/group-riding/alcohol-drug-fatigue chapters, plus a full Three-Wheel Motorcycle and Sidecar Supplement and a Hand Signals/T-CLOCS checklist section) -- 243 questions across 15 topic buckets survive after the build pipeline's dedup, comparable in scale to other MSF-manual-based states in this rollout (TX 241, AL 224) since it lacks only AL's extra state-statute supplement pages.
